title: Pedaleira amp description
description: An amp as data (format "pedaleira-amp", version 1). Documented in docs/amp-framework.md; the loader (plugin/src/effects/amp/dsp/AmpDescription.cpp) is the authority and also rejects unknown fields, a link without a coupling capacitor, a panel target that does not match its control, and a second gain pot.

default_voicing.description: The voicing a block starts on when this description is loaded into an amp.custom block (index into voicings).

name.description: The amp's name; shown as the block's name.

licence.description: The licence of this description file (an SPDX identifier such as "MIT", "CC0-1.0", "CC-BY-4.0", or a name). The description is data you own; say what others may do with it.

summary.description: A sentence or two about the amp and what the description is based on.

family.description: Which family the block picker files the amp under (High gain, Clean, Crunch). Leave it out for an amp that is none of them.

references.description: Where the values come from: schematic names, papers, measurements.

metadata.description: Who made the description and under what terms.

stage_solver.description: "classic": one-pole filters and a static waveshaper (cheap, the shipped high-gain amp). "wdf": wave digital filter trees with the tube as a nonlinear root (slower, closer to the circuit).

model.description: How the networks around each tube are solved.

grid_leak_ohm.description: The first grid leak to ground. Unit: ohm.

grid_stopper_ohm.description: The grid stopper resistor in series with the first grid. Unit: ohm.

miller_f.description: Capacitance the stopper works against (the first stage's Miller capacitance). Unit: F.

source_ohm.description: The guitar's source impedance; sets how fast the first coupling capacitor charges when the grid conducts. Unit: ohm.

input.description: The input jack up to the first grid.

tube.description: "12AX7" (or "ECC83"), "12AT7" ("ECC81"), "12AU7" ("ECC82"), or {"mu": ..., "rp_ohm": ...}. Datasheet small-signal constants at a typical operating point.

plate_load_ohm.description: The plate resistor Ra to the supply. Unit: ohm.

plate_capacitance_f.description: Capacitance on the plate: wiring plus the next stage's Miller capacitance. With the plate impedance it sets the stage's high-frequency roll-off. Unit: F.

resistor_ohm.description: The cathode resistor Rk. With the bias current it sets the bias voltage, which sets where the curve clips. Unit: ohm.

bias_current_a.description: The plate current at rest. Unit: A.

bypass_capacitor_f.description: The cathode bypass capacitor in farads, or "ideal" (a short for audio, the default), or "none" (unbypassed).

cutoff_v.description: Grid voltage that cuts the plate current off. Defaults to 3.5 for a 12AX7 and is required for any other tube. Unit: V.

contact_potential_v.description: Grid conduction starts this far below zero grid-cathode volts. Unit: V.

conduction_ohm.description: Resistance of the conducting grid-cathode diode. Unit: ohm.

max_bias_shift_v.description: Ceiling of the grid-conduction bias shift. Unit: V.

grid.description: The grid model: catalogue and fitted values.

capacitance_f.description: The coupling capacitor to the next grid; leave it out when every voicing gives it. Unit: F.

series_ohm.description: A series resistor into the next grid. Unit: ohm.

grid_leak_ohm.description: The next grid leak to ground. Unit: ohm.

coupling.description: The network to the next grid. Not allowed on the last stage.

resistance_ohm.description: Total resistance of the pot. Unit: ohm.

floor_ohm.description: A fixed resistor between the pot and ground, so the control does not reach silence. Unit: ohm.

source_ohm.description: What drives the pot: the previous plate load. Defaults to the stage's plate_load_ohm. Unit: ohm.

load_ohm.description: What loads the wiper (classic solver only; the wdf solver uses the real coupling network). Defaults to the coupling grid leak. Unit: ohm.

taper.description: Resistance law of the pot: the resistance below the wiper is R * position ^ taper (3.3 is about 10 percent at half rotation, an audio taper).

bright_capacitor_f.description: The bright capacitor across the upper part of the pot; 0 for none. Unit: F.

gain_pot.description: The gain pot with its bright capacitor, between this stage's plate and its coupling.

stages.description: One entry per gain stage, in signal order, 1 to 6 of them. The first is the input stage. Every stage but the last has a `coupling`; one stage may have a `gain_pot` (between its plate and its coupling).

coupling_capacitors_f.description: One capacitance per link (stage k to stage k + 1), or null to use the stage's own `coupling.capacitance_f`. Recorded as fitted values.

source_ohm.description: Rectifier plus transformer winding resistance. Unit: ohm.

full_load_a.description: Supply current at full output. Unit: A.

attack_s.description: How fast the load builds (depends on the music, not the supply). Unit: s.

rectifier.description: "solid_state", "tube" or "none": a label, the source resistance already contains the effect.

supply.description: Overrides of `power_amp.supply` for this voicing; anything left out is taken from there.

voicings.description: 1 to 3 voicings: the interstage capacitors and the supply the voicing switch selects.

bass_pot_ohm.description: R2, used as a variable resistor. Unit: ohm.

slope_ohm.description: R4, the slope resistor. Unit: ohm.

tone_stack.description: The passive tone stack: treble, middle and bass pots with a slope resistor (the Fender / Marshall TMB), solved in closed form (Yeh and Smith).

present.description: Whether the amp has a loop.

effects_loop.description: A placeholder: the loop is read and kept, the signal does not pass through one.

tube.description: A label for the output tubes.

topology.description: "push_pull_ab" has crossover character; "push_pull_a" has none; "solid_state" has none and is linear up to its rail, where it clips flat.

open_loop_gain.description: Forward gain of the stage before its saturation.

series_ohm.description: The feedback resistor from the output back. Unit: ohm.

shunt_ohm.description: The shunt resistor it divides against: beta = shunt / (shunt + series). Unit: ohm.

delay_free.description: Solve the feedback loop within the sample (Newton's method on the stage's curve) instead of feeding back the previous output. Keeps a strong loop stable; without it a large loop gain can oscillate above the audio band.

min_ohm.description: Resistance left with the pot turned fully up. Unit: ohm.

capacitor_f.description: The capacitor in series with it, across the shunt resistor. Unit: F.

presence.description: The presence network: removes high-frequency feedback.

inductance_h.description: Resonance branch inductance (the speaker impedance peak). Unit: H.

resistance_ohm.description: Its resistance: sets the width. Unit: ohm.

max_cut.description: The largest fraction of that band's feedback removed at full depth.

source_ohm.description: What drives the network (the phase inverter's plate). Unit: ohm.

pot_ohm.description: The tone cut pot. Unit: ohm.

min_ohm.description: Resistance left in the branch with the cut fully up. Unit: ohm.

capacitor_f.description: The capacitor in series with the pot. Unit: F.

tone_cut.description: A tone cut ahead of the output tubes: a pot (plus a fixed resistor) in series with a capacitor that shunts the drive. Turned up it takes the highs away. The presence control can drive it.

high_corner_hz.description: Output transformer high corner (two poles in the feedback path). Unit: Hz.

low_corner_hz.description: Output transformer low corner (the output DC blocker). Unit: Hz.

frequency_hz.description: Centre of the peak. Unit: Hz.

gain_db.description: Height of the peak. Unit: dB.

output_resonance.description: The speaker's impedance peak seen at the output of an amp with little or no global feedback: a peak after the output transformer. Left out: none.

knee_mix.description: 0 is a soft knee, 1 a sharp one.

ratio.description: Small-signal gain at idle relative to full gain (class AB crossover).

width.description: Level over which the notch recovers.

crossover.description: Class AB crossover character; ignored (ratio 1) for push_pull_a.

b_plus_v.description: Unloaded high-voltage rail B+. Unit: V.

source_ohm.description: Rectifier plus transformer winding resistance. Unit: ohm.

full_load_a.description: Supply current at full output. Unit: A.

attack_s.description: How fast the load builds. Unit: s.

supply.description: The supply, sag depth = source resistance * full load current / B+, recovery time = source resistance * reservoir.

input_full_scale_v.description: Digital full scale at the first grid, in volts. Unit: V.

power_drive_v.description: Volts at the tone stack output (after the master) that drive the power stage to full swing; stands for the recovery stage and phase inverter. Unit: V.

coupling_gain_rise.description: How much the interstage corners rise with gain (factor 1 + rise at full gain): the gain-dependent tightening of the low end.

invert_output.description: Flip the output's polarity, for an amp whose real counterpart comes out inverted against its input.

output_trim.description: Scale from the power stage's swing to digital.

control_smoothing_s.description: How fast the knobs glide. Unit: s.

calibration.description: Values with no component behind them; they tie the model to levels.

panel.description: The front panel: which knobs exist, what each drives, its taper and range. Leave it out for every knob the parts allow, linear, full travel.

label.description: The name shown for the control.

target.description: The part the knob moves. Must be the one that control can drive (see the table in docs/amp-framework.md).

taper.description: position = low + (high - low) * knob ^ taper. Defaults to 1, or 2 for the master.

range.description: [low, high]: the part of the pot's travel the knob covers.

faceplate.description: How the panel is drawn: colour, nameplate, knob caps, switch styles, the boxes the controls sit in. It does not touch the sound. Leave it out for a plain default panel.

nameplate.description: Where the nameplate sits. Default left.

tag.description: The short style tag on the nameplate, such as "US Lead".

character.description: The line under the amp name that says what it is like.

strip.description: The signature strip pattern on the nameplate. Default none.

knob_cap.description: The shape of the knob caps. Default round. A fader is a vertical slider instead of a knob.

groups.description: The boxes of the panel, left to right, each with its controls in order. Every control of the panel must be in exactly one box.

columns.description: Columns the knobs of the box use. Default one per knob.

default_cab.description: The cab the amp is meant to be heard through: the settings of a cab.model block (docs/cab-framework.md). Optional, a suggestion only; nothing of the amp's own sound depends on it.

speaker.description: The speaker's name as its description gives it (a shipped one: Granite, Ember, Velvet, Brass, Oak, Flint).

position_percent.description: Where the mic points: 0 at the centre of the cone, 100 at its edge.

distance_cm.description: From the grille cloth to the mic.

angle_deg.description: The mic's tilt off the speaker's axis.
